name: Kikai no Gokan - Another Stories Vol. 1
original_name: 機械の五感 Another stories vol.1
source:
On the morning of dating anniversary main character wonders what present to give to his lover. The outcome depends on the place chosen to visit.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
約會紀念日的早晨，主角思考著該送什麼禮物給戀人。結果取決於他選擇前往的地點。
